rationale: Steven is building brain-inspired personal AI agents with a focus on private, local-first architecture, while John brings deep cloud infrastructure and ML-ops expertise from his work at Cloudfitters—a natural pairing where Steven's AI agent vision meets John's operational leadership and systems-level thinking. Both are aligned on agentic AI as the next shift beyond chat interfaces, and John's background in cloud-native infrastructure and developer-community building could inform how TinyHumans scales its open-source agent platform.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet John Komarnicki — you're both focused on where AI is heading (Steven building local-first personal agents, John working on cloud infrastructure and agentic systems), and your complementary backgrounds in protocol design and ops could spark something useful at the hackathon.
